title: Roman Stewart - I was Lonely / One Heavy Duba

lines.l: Once upon a time, I almost lost my mind, I was lonely, I was lonely, yes, once upon a time.
Hoping every day things would come my way.
I was lonely, yes, I was lonely, yes, once upon a time.
I never knew what love could do
I never knew what love could do
Believe me, Lord, I was lonely
